subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Hiest**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling and meaning of the chosen word are:
 
 
• **Heist: **an act of stealing something from a shop or bank, especially something extremely valuable. (दुकान या बैंक से बहुमूल्य वस्तु की चोरी; सेंधमारी; लूट)
 
 
 
• Thus, the incorrectly spelt word is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Finery: **elegant and beautiful clothes and jewellery, especially those that are worn for a special occasion. (सुंदर व सुरुचिपूर्ण कपड़े व गहने)
 
• **Cringe: **to feel embarrassed. (झेंप जाना)
 
• **Defer: **to leave something until a later time. (किसी काम को स्‍थगित करना)

218:T479,
The correct answer is** looking for his book**.
